player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in **Ultimate Tic Tac Toe**.
Submit your move as **[macro  micro]** (two numbers 0-8):
• *macro*  = which mini-board you play in
• *micro* = which square inside that mini-board
Example `[7 8]` ➜ place your mark in mini-board 7, square 8, and
force your opponent to play in mini-board 8 next.

You are `{symbol}`.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Go šuthišwa go swanetše go ba ka sebopego sa [macro micro] le dinomoro tša 0-8.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Di-index ka moka di swanetše go ba magareng ga 0 le 8.
invalid_move.index_out_of_range: Leboto la micro_board, mothaladi goba khola e ka ntle ga lefelo.
invalid_move.cell_occupied: Sele e šetše e le gona.
invalid_move.wrong_micro_board: Sebapadi se swanetše go bapala lepatlelong la ka morago.
invalid_move.micro_board_won: Boto ya go laola e šetše e fentšwe.

next_board.any: boto e nngwe le e nngwe ya micro board

game_action.played: Modiri {player_id} o dile mo boradinyana {macro_idx}, selo {micro_idx} (mokala {row}, kolona {col}). Modiri {opponent_id} a swanetše go dula mo {nxt_txt}.

outcome.win: Sebapadi {player_id} se thopa Ultimate Tic Tac Toe!
